title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate | TechCrunch
summary: The institute lists DeepMind co-founder Shane Legg, Google executive James Manyika, and Google DeepMind chair Demis Hassabis as directors, with Legg serving as managing editor. Under his framework, developers would initially submit models voluntarily for review up to 30 days before release.
